findings.description:
Reentrancy in FlashArbitrageExecutor.execute(bytes32,address,uint256,FlashArbitrageExecutor.Hop[],uint256,uint256) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#44-60):
	External calls:
	- IAavePool(POOL).flashLoanSimple(address(this),asset,amount,params,0) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#57)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- phase = 0 (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#59)
	FlashArbitrageExecutor.phase (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#26) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- FlashArbitrageExecutor.execute(bytes32,address,uint256,FlashArbitrageExecutor.Hop[],uint256,uint256) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#44-60)
	- FlashArbitrageExecutor.executeOperation(address,uint256,uint256,address,bytes) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#61-92)
	- FlashArbitrageExecutor.idle() (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#32)

FlashArbitrageExecutor.executeOperation(address,uint256,uint256,address,bytes) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#61-92) has external calls inside a loop: beforeIn = IERC20(h.tokenIn).balanceOf(address(this)) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#70)

FlashArbitrageExecutor.executeOperation(address,uint256,uint256,address,bytes) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#61-92) has external calls inside a loop: IERC20(h.tokenIn).balanceOf(address(this)) != beforeIn - current (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#75)

FlashArbitrageExecutor.executeOperation(address,uint256,uint256,address,bytes) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#61-92) has external calls inside a loop: beforeOut = IERC20(h.tokenOut).balanceOf(address(this)) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#69)

FlashArbitrageExecutor.executeOperation(address,uint256,uint256,address,bytes) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#61-92) has external calls inside a loop: current = IERC20(h.tokenOut).balanceOf(address(this)) - beforeOut (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#76)

Reentrancy in FlashArbitrageExecutor.execute(bytes32,address,uint256,FlashArbitrageExecutor.Hop[],uint256,uint256) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#44-60):
	External calls:
	- IAavePool(POOL).flashLoanSimple(address(this),asset,amount,params,0) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#57)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- context = bytes32(0) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#59)

Reentrancy in FlashArbitrageExecutor.executeOperation(address,uint256,uint256,address,bytes) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#61-92):
	External calls:
	- V2Adapter.swap(h.router,h.tokenIn,h.tokenOut,current,h.minOut,deadline) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#72)
	- V3Adapter.swap(h.kind,h.router,h.tokenIn,h.tokenOut,h.fee,current,h.minOut,deadline) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#73)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- Executed(intentId,asset,recipient,amount,premium,customerProfit,keccak256(bytes)(abi.encode(route))) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#90)
	- MerchantPaid(intentId,asset,merchant,merchantAmount) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#88)

FlashArbitrageExecutor.execute(bytes32,address,uint256,FlashArbitrageExecutor.Hop[],uint256,uint256) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#44-60) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- paused || amount == 0 || intentId == bytes32(0) || usedIntents[intentId] || ! loanAssets[asset] || deadline < block.timestamp || deadline > block.timestamp + 120 || route.length < 2 || route.length > 3 (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#46)

FlashArbitrageExecutor.executeOperation(address,uint256,uint256,address,bytes) (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#61-92) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- asset != expectedAsset || amount != expectedAmount || block.timestamp > deadline || IERC20(asset).balanceOf(address(this)) != start + amount (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#65)
Variable FlashArbitrageExecutor.POOL (src/FlashArbitrageExecutor.sol#15) is not in mixedCase
